_entries.name: ui5-smart-access/Popover.fragment.xml
_entries.code:
<core:FragmentDefinition
    xmlns="sap.m"
    xmlns:core="sap.ui.core"
>
    <Popover
        class="abicsAccessibilityPopover sapUiSmallMarginBeginEnd sapUiTinyMarginTop"
        id="abicsAccessibilityPopover"
        placement="Bottom"
        showArrow="false"
        title="{i18n>popover.title}"
        contentWidth="320px"
    >
        <customHeader>
            <Bar>
                <contentMiddle>
                    <Title text="{i18n>popover.header.title}" class="popoverTitle" />
                </contentMiddle>
                <contentRight>
                    <Button id="closePopoverButton" icon="sap-icon://decline" press=".onPopoverClosePress" tooltip="{i18n>aria.close}" ariaLabelledBy="" class="closePopoverButton"/>
                </contentRight>
            </Bar>
        </customHeader>
        <content>
            <core:Fragment
                fragmentName="ui5-smart-access.fragments.FontSizePanel"
                type="XML"
            />
            <core:Fragment
                fragmentName="ui5-smart-access.fragments.TextToSpeechPanel"
                type="XML"
            />
            <core:Fragment
                fragmentName="ui5-smart-access.fragments.ColorBlindnessPanel"
                type="XML"
            />
            <core:Fragment
                fragmentName="ui5-smart-access.fragments.BlueLightFilterPanel"
                type="XML"
            />
            <core:Fragment
                fragmentName="ui5-smart-access.fragments.NightModePanel"
                type="XML"
            />
            <core:Fragment
                fragmentName="ui5-smart-access.fragments.ToggleImagesPanel"
                type="XML"
            />
            <core:Fragment
                fragmentName="ui5-smart-access.fragments.ContrastModePanel"
                type="XML"
            />
        </content>
        <footer>
            <Toolbar class="resetAllToolbar">
                <core:Fragment
                    fragmentName="ui5-smart-access.fragments.ResetAllPanel"
                    type="XML"
                />
            </Toolbar>
        </footer>
    </Popover>
</core:FragmentDefinition>

_entries.name: ui5-smart-access/fragments/FontSizePanel.fragment.xml
_entries.code:
<core:FragmentDefinition xmlns="sap.m" xmlns:core="sap.ui.core">
   <Panel id="fontSizePanel" expandable="true" expanded="{settings>/fontSizeExpanded}" width="auto" class="fontSizePanel">
      <headerToolbar>
         <OverflowToolbar active="true" press=".onFontSizeToolbarPress">
          <core:Icon src="sap-icon://text" size="20px" />
          <Title text="{i18n>fontSize.title}"/>
         </OverflowToolbar>
      </headerToolbar>
      <content>
         <VBox justifyContent="Center" alignItems="Center" width="100%">
            <Text id="fontStepDisplay" text="{settings>/fontStep}" width="150px" textAlign="Center"/>
            <HBox alignItems="Center" width="150px" justifyContent="SpaceBetween">
               <Button id="decreaseFontButton" icon="sap-icon://less" press=".onDecreaseFontSize" tooltip="{i18n>aria.decreaseFontSize}"/>
               <Button id="resetFontButton" icon="sap-icon://refresh" press=".onResetFontSize" tooltip="{i18n>aria.resetFontSize}"/>
               <Button id="increaseFontButton" icon="sap-icon://add" press=".onIncreaseFontSize" tooltip="{i18n>aria.increaseFontSize}"/>
            </HBox>
         </VBox>
      </content>
   </Panel>
</core:FragmentDefinition>

_entries.name: ui5-smart-access/fragments/TextToSpeechPanel.fragment.xml
_entries.code:
<core:FragmentDefinition xmlns="sap.m" xmlns:core="sap.ui.core">
   <Panel id="ttsPanel" expandable="true" expanded="{settings>/ttsExpanded}" width="auto" class="ttsPanel">
      <headerToolbar>
         <OverflowToolbar active="true" press=".onTTSToolbarPress">
            <core:Icon src="sap-icon://microphone" size="20px" />
            <Title text="{i18n>tts.title}" />
         </OverflowToolbar>
      </headerToolbar>
      <content>
         <VBox justifyContent="Center" alignItems="Center" width="100%">
            <HBox alignItems="Center" width="200px" justifyContent="SpaceBetween">
               <Button id="ttsStartButton" text="{i18n>tts.start}" icon="sap-icon://begin" press=".onTTSStart"/>
               <Button id="ttsStopButton" text="{i18n>tts.stop}" icon="sap-icon://stop" press=".onTTSStop"/>
            </HBox>
            <VBox alignItems="Center" width="100%" justifyContent="SpaceBetween" >
               <Label text="{i18n>tts.speed}" labelFor="ttsRateSlider"/>
               <Slider id="ttsRateSlider" min="0.5" max="2" step="0.1" value="{settings>/ttsRate}" width="200px" change=".onTTSRateChange"/>
            </VBox>
            <VBox alignItems="Center" width="100%" justifyContent="SpaceBetween">
               <Label text="{i18n>tts.volume}" labelFor="ttsVolumeSlider"/>
               <Slider id="ttsVolumeSlider" min="0" max="1" step="0.1" value="{settings>/ttsVolume}" width="200px" change=".onTTSVolumeChange"/>
            </VBox>
            <HBox alignItems="Center" width="200px" justifyContent="SpaceBetween">
               <Label text="{i18n>tts.hover}" labelFor="ttsHoverSwitch"/>
               <Switch id="ttsHoverSwitch" state="{settings>/ttsHover}" change=".onTTSHoverChange"/>
            </HBox>
         </VBox>
      </content>
   </Panel>
</core:FragmentDefinition>

_entries.name: ui5-smart-access/fragments/ColorBlindnessPanel.fragment.xml
_entries.code:
<core:FragmentDefinition xmlns="sap.m" xmlns:core="sap.ui.core">
   <Panel id="colorBlindnessPanel" expandable="true" expanded="{settings>/colorBlindnessExpanded}" width="auto" class="colorBlindnessPanel">
      <headerToolbar>
         <OverflowToolbar active="true" press=".onColorBlindnessToolbarPress">
            <core:Icon src="sap-icon://palette" size="20px" />
            <Title text="{i18n>colorBlindness.title}" />
         </OverflowToolbar>
      </headerToolbar>
      <content>
         <VBox visible="{settings>/colorBlindnessVisible}" justifyContent="Center" alignItems="Center" width="100%">
            <HBox alignItems="Center" width="200px" justifyContent="SpaceBetween">
               <Select id="colorBlindnessSelect" selectedKey="{settings>/colorBlindnessType}" type="Default" change=".onColorBlindnessChange">
                  <items>
                     <core:Item key="none" text="{i18n>colorBlindness.none}" />
                     <core:Item key="protanopia" text="{i18n>colorBlindness.protanopia}" />
                     <core:Item key="deuteranopia" text="{i18n>colorBlindness.deuteranopia}" />
                     <core:Item key="tritanopia" text="{i18n>colorBlindness.tritanopia}" />
                     <core:Item key="achromatopsia" text="{i18n>colorBlindness.achromatopsia}" />
                  </items>
               </Select>
               <Button id="colorBlindnessResetButton" icon="sap-icon://refresh" press=".onColorBlindnessReset" tooltip="{i18n>aria.resetColorBlindness}"/>
            </HBox>
         </VBox>
      </content>
   </Panel>
</core:FragmentDefinition>
